title: Data and code for: Phenology and validation design shape machine learning attribution of a Sentinel-2 canopy moisture index in forest adjacent hazelnut stands of Türkiye
description: Parcel year tables, Google Earth Engine scripts and Python code for the analysis of seasonal NDMI decline in 10,066 pure hazelnut stands of the Turkish forest management plans, 2019 to 2026. Stand geometries are not included.
